<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="10"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y4Ce6jka_erO5OrFbncQ"> <mxGraphModel dx="1806" dy="1354" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Client
 participant Auth as auth-service
 participant Cache as Redis<br/>(idempotency cache)
 participant Fraud as fraud-service
 participant DB as Postgres<br/>(auth-service)
 participant Kafka as Kafka topic:<br/>auth.events
 participant Ledger as ledger-service
 participant LDB as Postgres<br/>(ledger-service)
 Note over Client, LDB: Happy path only - see per-flow sequence diagrams<br/>(authorise/capture/reverse-sequence.mmd) for idempotency,<br/>concurrency, and failure handling
 Client ->> Auth: POST /authorisations<br/>(authorise, amount, idempotencyKey)
 Auth ->> Cache: check idempotency key
 Cache -->> Auth: cache miss
 Auth ->> DB: check idempotency key<br/>(best-effort pre-check, before paying<br/>for a fraud-service call)
 DB -->> Auth: not found
 Auth ->> Fraud: POST /fraud/check
 Fraud -->> Auth: APPROVE
 Auth ->> DB: reserve funds +<br/>save authorisation (AUTHORISED)<br/>+ outbox event
 Auth ->> Cache: store response (TTL)
 Auth -->> Client: 201 Created (AUTHORISED)
 Auth ->> Kafka: publish AUTHORISATION_AUTHORISED<br/>(outbox poller)
 Kafka -->> Ledger: consume<br/>AUTHORISATION_AUTHORISED
 Ledger ->> LDB: save ledger entry +<br/>event log
 Client ->> Auth: POST /authorisations/{id}/captures<br/>(idempotencyKey)
 Auth ->> DB: settle reserved funds +<br/>save authorisation (CAPTURED)<br/>+ outbox event
 Auth -->> Client: 200 OK (CAPTURED)
 Auth ->> Kafka: publish AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED<br/>(outbox poller)
 Kafka -->> Ledger: consume<br/>AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED
 Ledger ->> LDB: save ledger entry +<br/>event log
